Business systems

Discuss your system

Contact channels remain disabled until ownership, monitoring and reply are verified.

What changes for the business.

For businesses outgrowing paper, disconnected spreadsheets or tools that do not reflect their day-to-day process.

One agreed record

Define which information is authoritative and who can change it.

Controls around changes

Use roles, validation and history where the workflow needs accountability.

Useful on the actual device

Design for the phones or computers the team already uses.

Backups before dependence

Agree storage, export, backup and restore requirements before real records are entrusted to the system.

What a scoped build can include.

Final deliverables, exclusions, responsibilities and operating costs are recorded before a commitment.

  • Workflow and data model
  • Role and approval requirements
  • Responsive interface design
  • Validation and history needs
  • Hosting, backup and support plan

How the work moves.

Each stage creates something you can review before the next decision.

Understand

Map the problem, current process and people responsible.

Build and test

Review the agreed scope with sample information and failure cases.

Prepare handover

Agree access, hosting, training, support and what remains outside scope.

Questions before a scope.

These answers state the current limits. A proposal records the project-specific terms.

Is OpenDuka ready for my business?

OpenDuka is in development and the website shows fictional sample data. Production readiness has not been approved.

Can you replace our accounting system?

That would require a separate assessment. A custom operational system should not be described as accounting, tax or regulatory software without verification.

Can staff use different roles?

Role requirements can be designed into a scoped system, but the exact controls need testing against the real workflow.

Start with the problem.

Describe what happens today and where work slows down. A live inquiry service will be introduced only after delivery and privacy controls are verified.
